title: “In folly ripe. In reason rotten” Putting machine theology to rest
reasoning: The paper is a philosophical and epistemological critique that characterizes the development of AI and deep learning as a form of "machine theology" or a "religion of the machine." It extensively evaluates the theological and religious metaphors used in the field, critiquing the "dogma" of computational reductionism and treating the Turing machine as a "god."
